_description: Analysis of RAG evaluation results from rag_eval_fusion_k10_v5.json
_fix_details: Analysis of current v5 failures; fixes not yet applied

root_causes.description: Retrieval was perfect (expected chunk rank 1), but generator produced an empty answer despite successful retrieval and 36s generation time.
causes: Model failure to handle ~30k character context (10 chunks × 3000 chars)
Possible max_tokens exhaustion or finish_reason not logged
Generative model (llama3) may have quality degradation with very long contexts
Previous v4 issue 'void answers → num_predict too small' not fully resolved
fixes_needed: Add finish_reason logging to generate_answer() to identify truncation
Experiment with smaller max_chunks (e.g., 5 instead of 10) to reduce context length
Consider using a model with better long-context handling (llama3.1, mistral, etc.)
Test with increased max_tokens generation limit (currently 2048 in run_eval.py)

root_causes.description: Expected chunk containing '5 private repositories' for Oxen.ai was not retrieved in top-10. Retrieved only unrelated LLM integration chunks.
causes: Chunk '4d313c5...' may not be indexed (needs verification)
Embedding model (nomic-embed-text) may not effectively capture 'Oxen.ai repositories privati'
BRF search may miss term matches if 'repositories' or 'privati' have tokenization issues
Hybrid fusion (RRF) may not boost the correct chunk if it's low-ranked in both lists
fixes_needed: Run debug script to verify chunk '4d313c5...' exists in both BRF and semantic indexes
If chunk missing, check ingestion pipeline (source file parsing)
If chunk present, analyze embeddings and BRF scores for this chunk
Consider query expansion: 'Oxen.ai' -> 'Oxen AI', 'private repos', 'repository count'
Test separate BRF vs semantic performance on this query

root_causes.description: Only 1/2 expected chunks retrieved. Got 'MLops in 4 week' chunk but missed 'Move data versioning Git→DVC' chunk from MLOps Zoomcamp DTC.
causes: Query requires bridging information across two course sources (Zoomcamp vs 4 Weeks)
Semantic search may prioritize one course context over the other
BRF may miss the specific phrase 'Move data versioning Git→DVC' due to tokenization
Hybrid fusion doesn't explicitly optimize for multi-source coverage
fixes_needed: Verify chunk 'db991e4d...' exists in indexes (BROKEN_LINK issue mentioned in docs)
If chunk exists, analyze why it's not retrieved: embedding distance, BRF rank
Consider query rewriting: split into two queries (one per course) then merge results
Increase top_k from 10 to 20 for multi-source queries
Add query expansion with course-specific terms (Zoomcamp, DTC, MLops in 4 weeks)

root_causes.description: Retrieval was correct (both expected chunks in top-10), but generator returned wrong values (tau_Ab=14, tau_L=67 instead of tau_Ab=20, tau_L=45). Multiple tau values exist in vault; model failed to select the 'grid search Huber Loss' context.
causes: Model lacks discriminative reasoning for numerical values in similar contexts
System prompt doesn't emphasize careful numerical extraction
Context includes multiple tau pairs (14,67 in 9217084b; 20,45 in 094d931+7fe2bf9; 20,62; 20,63)
Generator picked the first encountered pair (14,67) instead of the VirusWatch grid search result
fixes_needed: Enhance system prompt: 'When multiple numerical values exist, carefully match the specific context requested'
Consider chain-of-thought prompting for numerical queries: 'First identify all tau values, then select the one matching the query criteria'
Test with different generation models (gemma4:e4b may have better reasoning)
Add explicit instruction to 'DO NOT guess if multiple values exist - report the specific one matching the query context'

root_causes.description: Judge LLM returned truncated JSON/JSON-like content that extract_judge_scores() couldn't parse. Result: parse_error=true, verdict='unknown'.
causes: Judge response was longer than context limit (raw_content truncated at 300 chars)
Gemini-style 'reasoning' field may contain structured output but extraction logic fails
Judge model (llama3) may have inconsistent JSON output formatting
num_predict=2048 may be insufficient for complex reasoning cases
fixes_needed: Increase num_predict in judge.py from 2048 to 4096
Improve extract_judge_scores() regex patterns to handle partial JSON
Add fallback to parse reasoning field more aggressively
Consider using gemma4:e4b as judge (better structured output handling)
Log full judge response for debugging even if parsing fails

root_causes.description: run_eval.py uses different prompts, models, and parameters than production rag_agent.py. Evaluation results may not represent real system performance.
causes: run_eval.py: system prompt in English, simple prompt, max_tokens=2048, httpx direct calls
rag_agent.py: system prompt in Italian, structured prompt, max_tokens=4096, pydantic-ai abstraction
Different error handling and logging approaches
Evaluation uses offline generation, production uses agent framework
fixes_needed: Align run_eval.py generation with rag_agent.py parameters (Italian prompt, max_tokens=4096)
Consider extracting generate_answer logic to shared module
Document evaluation limitations and potential divergence from production
Run production-style evaluation via API endpoint to validate alignment
